subject: Secure build controls evidence request — FinTechCo SIG follow-up

Cc: 
Date: Tue, 28 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG - secure build controls evidence request

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. As part of our SIG review we need granular evidence for your secure build and deployment controls focused on code review, CI/CD access, and change approvals. Specifically: 
- The code review policy and an example PR showing review approvals and required checks.
- CI job run logs that show enforcement of branch protection and secrets redaction.
- Role-based access for build agents and any ephemeral credential usage (proof of rotation).
- Change management approvals for a recent production deployment (ticket or approval trail).

Can you share these artifacts or point us to a secure link? We are on a two-week audit window and would prefer to close this out by next Friday if possible.

Appreciate it,
Aisha Malik
Security PM, FinTechCo
Aisha.malik@fintechco.com

--
Attachment: request_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
From: chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwood.inference.com>

Hi Aisha — thanks for the detailed checklist. We're happy to provide the artifacts and will prioritize the items you listed. Quick summary of what I'm attaching and next steps: 

Attachments included in this reply:
- code_review_policy_v2.pdf -> our canonical code review policy (covers required approvers, blocking checks, and SCA gating)
- build_pipeline_access_matrix.csv -> RBAC mapping for Jenkins/GitHub Actions runners and service accounts
- ci_job_run_log_20280301.txt -> redacted run log demonstrating secrets masking and branch protection enforcement

What we still plan to provide by EOD tomorrow (links):
- Example PR with review thread and required-status passes (we'll share a secure, time-limited link to the archived PR export)
- Change approval trail for the March 15 canary rollout (SUP-2191 ticket and the approval e-mail chain)

Internal owners looped for logs and the PR export: Vivek Kulkarni (Infra), Neha Kapoor (SecOps).

If you need evidence in a different format (SIG toolkit zips, CAIQ mapping), say the word and we'll adapt.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Manager, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.inference.com
